items.description: An automated trading bot copied the attack on K3 Capital's sBOLD vault, taking more than half the funds and paying most of its proceeds to get its transactions processed first.

items.title: Crypto Long & Short: Crypto exchanges shouldn’t double as the vault
items.description: A single breach moved billions out of Binance in minutes, exposing how much client money sits with the venue that trades it. Darren Jordan of Komainu argues institutions should keep trading and custody separate, as traditional markets have for decades, and sets out the questions to ask about where assets are held.

items.title: Bitcoin carry trades could beat Treasury bills in 2027, Sygnum predicts
items.description: Sygnum predicts that Bitcoin carry trades may offer higher returns than Treasury bills in 2027, following a sharp drop in funding rates that made the strategy less compelling in 2026.

items.title: Binance hackers stole 192 tokens across 11 networks, court docs show
